files:
CREATE TABLE `files` (
  `id` binary(16) NOT NULL,
  `bucket` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `object_key` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `public_url` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `original_filename` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `content_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `extension` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `size_bytes` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `purpose` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `etag` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `version_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `owner_id` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `owner_type` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ref_id` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `visibility` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `created_by` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `completed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `deleted_by` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `object_key` (`object_key`),
  KEY `idx_files_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_files_owner` (`owner_id`),
  KEY `idx_files_ref` (`ref_id`),
  KEY `idx_files_visibility` (`visibility`),
  KEY `idx_files_purpose` (`purpose`),
  KEY `idx_files_object_key` (`object_key`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
file_references:
CREATE TABLE `file_references` (
  `id` binary(16) NOT NULL,
  `file_id` binary(16) NOT NULL,
  `ref_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `ref_id` binary(16) NOT NULL,
  `usage_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `created_by` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_by` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `ai_report_ref_id` binary(16) GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`ref_type` = _utf8mb4'AI_REPORT') and (`usage_type` = _utf8mb4'ORIGINAL') and (`is_deleted` = false)) then `ref_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `ai_report_file_id` binary(16) GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`ref_type` = _utf8mb4'AI_REPORT') and (`usage_type` = _utf8mb4'ORIGINAL') and (`is_deleted` = false)) then `file_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_file_ref` (`file_id`,`ref_type`,`ref_id`,`usage_type`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_ai_report_original_report` (`ai_report_ref_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_ai_report_original_file` (`ai_report_file_id`),
  KEY `idx_ref` (`ref_type`,`ref_id`),
  KEY `idx_file_references_file_id` (`file_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_file_references_file` FOREIGN KEY (`file_id`) REFERENCES `files` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
business_sequences:
CREATE TABLE `business_sequences` (
  `sequence_key` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `current_value` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`sequence_key`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
